item.title: SuperTalk Eagle Hour 1/30/2026
item.description: The countdown to Southern Miss baseball continues with former Southern Miss and MLB baseball player Kurt McCarty. The radio voice of the James Madison Dukes, Dave Riggert, previews tomorrow’s basketball match-up with the Golden Eagles at Reed-Green Coliseum. Plus, Dima has news and notes.

item.title: Bill reforming Mississippi’s CON laws heads to governor’s desk with unanimous support
item.description: A bill reforming Mississippi’s certificate of need laws has passed both chambers of the state legislature with unanimous support and awaits a signature from Gov. Tate Reeves. item.title: Police: 3, including child, dead in Hattiesburg murder-suicide
item.description: Three people, including a 3-year-old child, were found dead in Hattiesburg in what police say was a murder-suicide. item.title: New mobile app launched connecting Mississippians to attorney general’s office
item.description: Mississippians can now download an app that connects them to resources offered by the state’s attorney general’s office.
